title: Iceland Ring Road & Snæfellsnes Expedition
description: A 15-day self-drive photography expedition around Iceland's Ring Road (Route 1), Golden Circle, South Coast, Vatnajökull glaciers, Eastfjords, Northern Diamond Circle, and Snæfellsnes Peninsula (96 curated stops, 789 photos, 2,990 km).
